description: radical hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy for an ulcerated HPV-associated non-keratinising squamous cell carcinoma, 28 mm and 9 mm deep, adjacent HSIL, margins clear, four negative pelvic sentinel nodes, pT1b2 pN0(sn)
report:
Uterus with cervix and bilateral adnexa, radical hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy

Received in formalin is a radical hysterectomy specimen. There is an ulcerated tumour in the left superior (anterior) quadrant measuring 28 x 20 mm. Representative sections are taken in 24 blocks.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Radical hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy
- Hysterectomy type: Laparoscopic
- Tumour site: Left superior (anterior) quadrant (12 to 3 o'clock)
- Tumour size: 28 mm (greatest dimension)
  - All dimensions: 28 x 20 x 12 mm

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Squamous cell carcinoma, HPV-associated
- p16 immunohistochemistry: Positive
- Depth of stromal invasion: Greater than 5 mm (deepest 9 mm)
- Depth of stromal invasion (proportion): Middle one-third
- Horizontal extent of stromal invasion: Not applicable
- Other tissue / organ involvement: Not identified
- Lymphovascular invasion: Not identified
- Perineural invasion: Not identified
- Tumour histology:
  Sections of the cervix show involvement by HPV-associated squamous cell carcinoma with a non-keratinising pattern, in the left superior (anterior) quadrant. Infiltrating nests and sheets of atypical squamous cells show intercellular bridges but no keratin pearls.

Margins
- Surgical margins: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma
  - Vaginal cuff margin: 15 mm; uninvolved by intraepithelial neoplasia
  - Radial (circumferential) margin: left parametrium, 6 mm

Lymph nodes
- Pelvic lymph nodes: 4 examined (sentinel); none involved

Pathological stage (AJCC 9th edition)
- pTNM: pT1b2 pN0(sn)

Additional findings
- Additional pathologic findings: High-grade squamous intraepithelial lesion
  (CIN 2 or 3)

UTERUS with CERVIX AND BILATERAL ADNEXA, radical hysterectomy and bilateral
salpingo-oophorectomy:
- SQUAMOUS CELL CARCINOMA, HPV-associated
- Margins clear
- 0 of 4 pelvic sentinel lymph nodes involved
- pT1b2 pN0(sn) (AJCC 9th edition).
